evidence_standard.conflict_rule: Literal context dates remain original evidence. A proposed corrected semantic period is permitted only as a separate conditional normalization when independent in-source structure proves a table-column relationship; never overwrite the original context.
evidence_standard.unsupported_rule: If no independent period proof or deterministic table-column linkage exists, retain literal context and fail closed.

applicability_all_required: Official filing is eligible before decision and source hash verifies.
Selected audited consolidated annual base context exists.
A quarter-duration OneD base context and annual-duration FourD base context share the same annual end date.
OneReportableSegmentRevenue and FourReportableSegmentRevenue groups contain matching reportable segment descriptions/identities.
One-group segment revenues reconcile to OneD total SegmentRevenue within XBRL rounding tolerance.
Four-group segment revenues reconcile to FourD total SegmentRevenue within XBRL rounding tolerance.

At least one additional segment measure family, when present with One/Four groups and totals, independently preserves the same One/Four column mapping; otherwise proof state remains weaker and no correction is promoted.
Units, currency, scale, audit status and consolidated scope are compatible.
conditional_rule.proposed_normalization: Preserve original Four-segment literal context dates; add proposed_period = FourD annual period and proof linkage to the One/Four table-column bridge.
conditional_rule.note: This rule does not infer annuality from the word Four, magnitude, or reconciliation alone. It requires explicit Yearly filing metadata plus paired One/Four base contexts and deterministic same-filing table-column structure.
